_meta.description: Curated SYNTHETIC accommodation database used when no Amadeus API key is configured and as the fallback when the Amadeus sandbox is unreachable.
_meta.important: Every property name in this file is INVENTED. No real hotel, brand or certification holder is described here. The assignment brief notes that no reliable free API exposes eco-certification status, so this mock database stands in for one. Certification scheme names are real schemes, but their attachment to these fictional properties is illustrative only and MUST be surfaced to the user as demonstration data (see DATA_PROVENANCE_NOTICE in actions/api_clients.py).

schema.cert: Certification scheme claimed by the property
schema.cert_tier: 1 = third-party audited against a GSTC-recognised standard, 2 = third-party audited, 3 = self-declared
schema.price_eur: Indicative price per room per night
schema.energy: Share of electricity from on-site or contracted renewable generation (0-1)
schema.single_use_plastic_free: Property reports eliminating single-use plastics in guest areas
schema.transit_min: Walking minutes to the nearest rail or metro station
schema.local_sourcing: Share of food and beverage sourced within 150 km (0-1)
